why: the registration record for a raw action server (name, type names, hashes, QoS, callbacks) -- the values rclcpp_action passes to `create_server` as separate arguments, gathered into one struct because the entity is registered from generated code rather than written by hand. Moved to `nros::internals` by phase-506 W1 (RFC-0071 D12): the untyped action machinery the C and C++ shims drive, off the top-level user API.
